immutableLedgerRequirements: The final variant roster and every expected disposition and semantic stage are authored, independently reviewed, canonicalized, hashed, and made read-only before producer, SUT, or oracle execution.
No expectation, expected stage, expected code, family membership, or antecedent relation may be derived from SUT, oracle, VM, node, compiler, or referee results.
Each row changes exactly one stated invariant from named independently accepting positive antecedents; compound mutations are separate families or explicitly enumerated cross-product variants.
Each negative row names all positive antecedents required to reach its exact rejection stage, and those antecedents must independently accept in the same pinned attempt.
Each positive row expects ACCEPT at FINAL_ACCEPT; each negative row expects REJECT at one exact semantic stage; a precondition row may expect REFUSE only at PRECONDITION_REFUSAL.
Wildcard, any-reject, implementation-native, result-derived, null, and __AUTO_STRICT__ expectations are forbidden.
Every row has a stable case ID, stable variant ID, one RF family ID, exact mutation description, exact expected disposition, exact semantic stage, and pinned input digest.

The ledger is complete only when every frozen variant appears exactly once, every referenced antecedent exists, family and variant arithmetic reconcile, and an independent reviewer signs the ledger digest.

refereeAllowed: producer input digest and public case order
sutDenied: producer output other than the opaque case bytes
